newsitem.title: USA: Aetna sees Brazil venture accretive in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Aetna sees Brazil venture accretive in 1997.

text.p: Aetna Inc said it expects a new Brazilian joint venture to be accretive to earnings by the end of the year.
Aetna earlier this week said it agreed to make an initial investment of about $300 million to acquire up to 49 percent of a joint venture with Sul America Seguros, Brazil's largest insurance company.
The joint venture, to be called Sul America Aetna and to be based in Sao Paulo, would provide health and life insurance as well as pension plans in Brazil.
Aetna's initial investment would be followed by up to an additional $90 million over time based on future performance of the venture.
The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter.
